name: Vigil arsenal: VW2 detailed weapon set
registry: tools/arsenal.py WEAPONS2 (VW2-01..16); tools/armory.py VW/VA left unchanged
frame: mm at print scale; x to the muzzle, z up, origin = main grip / fist centre (knife and breaching tool: grip along z; grenade and charge: base at z = 0)

hand_fit.note: same block as VW-01..07, so exosuit.fist() closes over it; FORE in tools/arsenal.py gives the support-hand point

detail_rules_mm.grip_texture: finger grooves r 0.19 mm, side grooves 0.34 x 0.18 mm

exaggerations: barrels 1.0-1.4 mm (true 1:56 bore/barrel would be 0.3-0.5 mm)
panel lines 0.35 mm wide (true 6 mm seams would be 0.1 mm)
rail teeth 0.42 mm on a 0.85 mm pitch (true picatinny 5.2 mm pitch would be 0.09 mm)
knife blade 1.0 mm thick at the spine, edge a 0.4 mm rounded flat (no knife edge)
grips sized to the Vigil gauntlet (1.0 x 1.1 mm), not to a scaled human hand

catalog.revision_note: VW2 series: 16 detailed weapons as loose parts, sized for the Vigil hands
catalog.description: Second-generation Vigilant weapons, more detailed than VW-01..08: VW2-01 Glaive service rifle, VW2-02 Quarrel carbine, VW2-03 Bodkin marksman rifle, VW2-04 Ranseur grenadier rifle, VW2-05 Thresher drum shotgun, VW2-06 Rondel PDW, VW2-07 Culverin heavy revolver, VW2-08 Awl service pistol, VW2-09 Partisan LMG, VW2-10 Arbalest rail rifle, VW2-11 Censer plasma projector, VW2-12 Ballista launcher, VW2-13 Misericorde combat knife, VW2-14 Crowbill breaching tool, VW2-15 Cinder grenade, VW2-16 Petard breaching charge. Panel lines, vent slots, rails, separate magazines, optics, muzzle devices and grip texture at 0.35-0.4 mm.
buildNotes: Defined in tools/arsenal.py (WEAPONS2 registry, VW2-01..16); built by tools/bitspack.py on a 0.05 mm SDF grid; display sheets by source/sheet.py.
Every pistol grip is the VW grip block (1.0 x 1.1 x 2.0 mm at the origin), so figures hold VW2 weapons with the existing gauntlets.
Barrels 1.0-1.4 mm, panel lines 0.35 x 0.25 mm, vent slots 0.4 x 0.3 mm, rail teeth 0.42 mm; see DESIGN.md.
catalog.limitations: Procedural designs; printability is a heuristic screen (unified-CAD-MCP), not a test print. Print meshes are simplified by manifold3d only as far as the 280k-triangle check budget needs (tolerance in reports/build.json).
